done_when: Review reports an emoji used as an icon on a client app screen as a finding.

known.title: Not done: Review reports an emoji used as an icon on a client app screen as a finding.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - reviewing an unsigned client prototype and its subsequent sign-off.
The icon instruction is added only to the normal review's `rules` block. `src/forge/review.py:375–377` substitutes `review-light.md` for unsigned working prototypes; that template explicitly limits findings to demo breakage, security and data loss. Sign-off also bypasses this block (`src/forge/review.py:1146`). Consequently, these normal client-screen review paths never receive the new icon rule. The added tests cover ordinary close only, so both pass despite this delivery gap. Deliver the instruction through the prototype and sign-off paths and cover their prompt delivery.
findings.title: Not done: Review reports an emoji used as an icon on a client app screen as a finding.

stop.reason: Owner chose one more round: add the same rule to the prototype light review and the sign-off review

why: Client app screens can use emoji as icons, which clash with the lucide icons the starter and shadcn use, and nothing shipped stops it or makes review report it.
